name: Xiao Yang
title: Full-Stack & AI Engineer
bio: I build full-stack systems around AI. At NEURAI Lab I work on YouDescribeX, a platform that generates audio descriptions of YouTube videos for blind and low-vision viewers. On my own time I ship local-first LLM tools that run without an API key.

experience.description: Secured 43 REST endpoints, resolved session conflicts between the dev and prod deployments, and debugged the AI description pipeline end to end.
Building a headless Shopify storefront with Next.js, covering product catalog, cart, and checkout for a metal EDC brand.
